title: Weekly: 8 free repos you missed (13-19 Nov)

instagram.caption:
8 free GitHub repos you missed this week 👀 Save this before it gets buried.

#1 Astryx: Meta's own design system, now open source (150+ React components)
#2 Sherlock: find every account tied to one username across 400+ sites
#3 Ruff: lints all of CPython in 0.29s (Pylint takes 60s+)
#4 Infradeck: every server, container and service in one self-hosted dashboard
#5 Codex Security: OpenAI's open-source AI bug hunter
#6 MuJoCo: the physics engine robots learn to walk in, now free
#7 DarkProof: text your family with no internet and no signal
#8 4R022 Heart: "I love you" in 30 languages, on every screen

Which one are you trying first? 👇
